title: Microsoft Edge: AI tab and Workspace organisation suggestions in version 155
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, default state, data handling and both policy controls are supported. Licensing should distinguish the published OneDrive for Business prerequisite for creating enterprise Workspaces from the absence of suggestion-specific licensing, and the user-toggle checklist item has no controls-table row.
